8004.gloss: Selection quality swings by hiring manager for 45.8%
8004.verbatim: 45.8% of HR and TA practitioners describe their process as inconsistent — confidence that it picks the best candidate rather than the best interviewer varies by hiring manager or role (n=131). [Q4]
8004.source_note: SHRM Labs x Testlify: Skills Assessments — Topline Report

8016.gloss: 73.4% are concerned about candidates using AI to cheat
8016.verbatim: 73.4% of HR and TA practitioners are concerned to some degree about candidates using AI during interviews or assessments, combining "very concerned" (12.5%), "concerned" (21.1%) and "somewhat concerned" (39.8%) (n=128). [Q12]
8016.source_note: SHRM Labs x Testlify: Skills Assessments — Topline Report
